title: bug: a join_team refused because the team is full still auto-registers the caller (a new IDLE worker record and WORKER_CREATED), breaking addTeamMember's "refuse a full team BEFORE any write", and that refusal is an uncoded Error while the handler's other refusals are coded
description:
Filed by defect hunt #9 (task-66961b32), lane: daemon team tool family. All paths are under packages/moe-daemon/ unless noted.

PROBLEM
- src/state/teamStore.ts:183-189 says "Order matters: refuse a full team BEFORE any write", then runs `throw new Error(\`Team ${existing.name} is full (max ${existing.maxSize} members)\`)`.
- src/tools/joinTeam.ts:71-80 auto-registers an unknown caller (state.createWorker, status IDLE) BEFORE addTeamMember (joinTeam.ts:82) refuses the full team. A refused join therefore writes a worker record and emits WORKER_CREATED.
- The existing test "still caps the live members at maxSize, and a refused join writes nothing" (src/tools/joinTeam.deadMembers.test.ts:66-74) checks only the team record.
- The refusal is a plain Error (teamStore.ts:189), while the same handler's sibling refusals are coded MoeErrors: missingRequired (joinTeam.ts:64-65) and notFound('Team') (joinTeam.ts:68). McpAdapter turns the plain Error into -32000 with no codeName and logs it at error level with a stack ("Tool failed", src/server/McpAdapter.ts:325-329).
- Impact is low. TOOL_AUDIENCE is [] (src/tools/index.ts:228). The wrappers join at pre-flight and retry before every claim while the team is full, matching on the message text only (scripts/moe-agent.sh:2140-2168). A refused probe, or a seat that never claims, leaves a stray IDLE record on the board and in list_workers until the stale prune, and every retry logs an error stack.

EVIDENCE (HEAD 39bec237, run in a git-archive snapshot outside the shared checkout)
- Repro: /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-66961b32/A/zzHuntA_joinFullWrites.test.ts, with its output in .out.txt beside it. The architect re-ran it in /tmp/hunt-6696-snap (verify-architect.txt). Tests 2 failed (2):
  - "a refused join leaves no new worker record and emits no WORKER_CREATED": received events ["WORKER_CREATED"] and record { id: "w-new", ... }.
  - "the full-team refusal is a coded MoeError like its sibling refusals": received { coded: false, codeName: null }.

FIX DIRECTION
- Make the full-team refusal a coded MoeError, e.g. invalidState or a MoeError with a TEAM_FULL codeName.
- Keep the message text "Team <name> is full (max N members)". The wrapper matches on it, and so do joinTeam.deadMembers.test.ts:73/94/149, joinTeam.notification.test.ts, workerType.test.ts and src/util/teamMembershipHeal.test.ts.
- Refuse before auto-registering. Either create the worker record only after addTeamMember succeeds, giving it the teamId, or run the same live-member check (DEAD members do not count) before createWorker.

FILES
- src/tools/joinTeam.ts
- src/state/teamStore.ts
- src/tools/joinTeam.deadMembers.test.ts
definitionOfDone: In src/tools/joinTeam.deadMembers.test.ts, a join_team by an unregistered workerId into a team whose live members fill it rejects. Afterwards state.getWorker(<id>) is null and no WORKER_CREATED event was emitted for that id.
The same file asserts that the refusal is a MoeError whose codeName is set and is not INTERNAL_ERROR, and that its message still contains "is full (max".

`cd packages/moe-daemon && npx vitest run src/tools/joinTeam.deadMembers.test.ts src/tools/joinTeam.notification.test.ts src/util/teamMembershipHeal.test.ts src/tools/workerType.test.ts` passes in a snapshot outside the shared checkout.

implementationPlan.description: teamStore: one shared, coded full-team predicate. In packages/moe-daemon/src/state/teamStore.ts add, just above addTeamMember, `export function assertTeamHasSeat(state: StateManager, team: Team, workerId: string): void`. It returns at once when `team.memberIds.includes(workerId)` (a current member always keeps its seat: addTeamMember's idempotent path and every wrapper pre-flight force re-join) or when `team.memberIds.length < team.maxSize`. Otherwise it counts live members as `team.memberIds.filter((id) => state.workers.get(id)?.status !== 'DEAD')`, so a member with no worker record is NOT dead and keeps its seat, exactly as today. When that count is >= maxSize it throws `new MoeError(MoeErrorCode.INVALID_STATE, `Team ${team.name} is full (max ${team.maxSize} members)`, { teamId: team.id, maxSize: team.maxSize }, 'TEAM_FULL')`; import MoeError and MoeErrorCode from '../util/errors.js'. Error handling: this replaces the plain `throw new Error(...)` at :189, so McpAdapter answers -32002 with data.codeName TEAM_FULL and logs at warn ("Tool rejected request") instead of -32000 plus an error-level stack. Use -32002 (not NOT_ALLOWED or CONSTRAINT_VIOLATION) because the refusal is retryable once a seat frees, the same reasoning as TASK_NOT_CLAIMED (docs/MCP_SERVER.md:114). Do not use invalidState(): its fixed '<entity> is in <state> state' text would lose the message. The text after the '[TEAM_FULL] ' prefix must stay byte-identical, because the wrappers print it and these assertions match it by substring: joinTeam.deadMembers.test.ts:73/94/149, joinTeam.notification.test.ts:127, workerType.test.ts:137 and teamMembershipHeal.test.ts:186. In addTeamMember, after the existing member early-return, replace the inline block at :186-192 with `assertTeamHasSeat(state, existing, workerId);` and then `if (existing.memberIds.length >= existing.maxSize) await evictDeadMembers(state, existing, <ids of existing.memberIds whose record is DEAD>)`. Keep the 'Order matters: refuse a full team BEFORE any write' comment on that call, so the refusal still precedes evictDeadMembers and clearMembershipTombstone. Behavior is otherwise identical: a team below maxSize never evicts, and DEAD members are evicted only when the live ones leave a seat. Do not add a StateManager delegate: tools already import store helpers directly (acquireResource.ts and waitForResource.ts import from ../state/resourceStore.js). Edit with the Edit tool only (global rail: no shell writes to tracked files).
implementationPlan.note: Added exported assertTeamHasSeat (coded TEAM_FULL, INVALID_STATE) and used it in addTeamMember before evictDeadMembers.

implementationPlan.description: join_team: refuse a full team before auto-registering. In packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/joinTeam.ts, import { assertTeamHasSeat } from '../state/teamStore.js'. Call `assertTeamHasSeat(state, team, params.workerId);` immediately after `if (!team) throw notFound('Team', params.teamId);` (:68) and BEFORE the `if (!state.getWorker(params.workerId))` auto-register block (:71-80). Add a one-line comment saying a full team is refused before the caller is registered, so a refused join writes no worker record and emits no WORKER_CREATED (DoD 1). Leave everything after it unchanged: createWorker, then state.addTeamMember (which re-runs the same predicate under the same global mutex, so every successful join behaves as today), then the DEAD revive, then refreshWorkerType last. Do not change the tool's description, inputSchema or result: the only contract change is the full-team refusal's code. Edit with the Edit tool only.

Regression tests in packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/joinTeam.deadMembers.test.ts (DoD 1 and 2). Imports to add: fs and path, plus `MoeError, MoeErrorCode` from '../util/errors.js'. Keep the additions to about 40 lines, and leave every existing assertion's text as it is (toThrow(string) matches a substring, so they still pass). (a) Extend 'still caps the live members at maxSize, and a refused join writes nothing'. Just before the refused `join('w-n3')` (w-n3 has no record), add `const events: string[] = []; const off = h.state.subscribe((e) => { events.push(e.type); });`, and call off() in a finally. After the existing `expect(teamNow()).toEqual(before)`, assert three things: `h.state.getWorker('w-n3')` is null; `fs.existsSync(path.join(h.moePath, 'workers', 'w-n3.json'))` is false; and `events` toEqual([]). The last means no event at all and so no WORKER_CREATED; at base it is ['WORKER_CREATED'] (the hunt repro). (b) New case 'refuses a full team with a coded TEAM_FULL MoeError'. Build the same team: fullWithTwoDead(), then join('w-new') and join('w-n2'). Capture the refusal with `const err = await join('w-n3').catch((e: unknown) => e);` and assert: toBeInstanceOf(MoeError); `codeName` toBe('TEAM_FULL') (so it is set and is not INTERNAL_ERROR); `code` toBe(MoeErrorCode.INVALID_STATE); and `message` toContain('is full (max 3 members)'). Also assert `h.state.addTeamMember(team.id, 'w-n3')` rejects toMatchObject({ codeName: 'TEAM_FULL' }), which covers the /ws ADD_TEAM_MEMBER path. (c) New case 'a current member re-joining its full team is never refused'. With the same three live members, `await join('w-c')` resolves and teamNow().memberIds stays ['w-c', 'w-new', 'w-n2']. This pins the member exemption: every wrapper pre-flight force re-joins its own team, so losing the exemption would leave every seat of a full team teamless. This test file is the one place these behaviours are pinned.

Successful joins, the eviction of DEAD members from a full team, and a current member's idempotent re-join are unchanged.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: (1) Create the worker record only after addTeamMember succeeds. Rejected: addTeamMember sets worker.teamId only when the record exists, and createWorker takes no teamId. A createWorker that fails after a successful add would also leave a recordless member, which keeps its seat. (2) Delete the auto-registered record on refusal. Rejected: it still writes the file and emits WORKER_CREATED, then WORKER_DELETED. (3) Copy the live-member check into joinTeam. Rejected: two copies drift. One exported predicate in teamStore.ts serves both callers. (4) Error code: TEAM_FULL under -32002, not CONSTRAINT_VIOLATION or NOT_ALLOWED, because a seat freeing makes a retry succeed (the TASK_NOT_CLAIMED reasoning, MCP_SERVER.md:114), and clients key on data.codeName (MCP_SERVER.md:91).
planningNotes.codebaseInsights: MoeError prefixes '[codeName] ' to its message, and vitest toThrow(string) matches a substring, so every existing 'is full' assertion keeps passing. The wrappers (moe-agent.sh retry_team_join, moe-agent.ps1 Invoke-MoeTeamJoinRetry and the startup join blocks) print error.message. They branch only on a 'Team not found: ' prefix, never on the full-team text. teamMembershipHeal pre-checks size and swallows errors. McpAdapter runs non-blocking tools under the global reentrant mutex, so join_team's check and addTeamMember's re-check see the same team. Tools already import store helpers directly (resourceStore.js).
planningNotes.risks: (1) Dropping the member exemption from the predicate would refuse every pre-flight force re-join of a full team's own member; step 3c pins it. (2) Counting a recordless member as DEAD would break the case where a member without a worker record keeps its seat (deadMembers test :143). (3) In addTeamMember the assert must stay before evictDeadMembers and clearMembershipTombstone. (4) The postflight and seat-registration fixtures still emit the old uncoded refusal. They stay valid because no wrapper branches on its code or text, so do not edit scripts/. (5) Other open rows also edit docs/MCP_SERVER.md, so keep this edit inside the join_team section.
